dog/00-1aed818d14.mp3.text: The man who helped a thirsty dog. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

dog/01-4f23ed1305.mp3.text: A long time ago, a man was walking through the desert. The sun was hot, and he was very thirsty.

dog/02-8a8565415e.mp3.text: He found a well, climbed down carefully, and drank some cool water. Alhamdulillah, he felt better.

dog/03-7a951cd56a.mp3.text: When he came back up, he saw a dog nearby. The dog was panting and licking the wet mud. It looked so thirsty, just like he had been.

dog/04-5d7f3415f9.mp3.text: The man thought, "This dog is thirsty the way I was thirsty." So he climbed down the well again, filled his shoe with water, held it carefully in his mouth so he could climb, and gave the water to the dog.

dog/05-4c7e25300c.mp3.text: The dog drank and drank until it was happy.  Allah was so pleased with this kind act that He forgave the man's sins.

dog/06-9c93cca82e.mp3.text: The Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him told us this story so we would remember that there is a reward for kindness to every living being.

dog/07-4139407d8a.mp3.text: What we learned. Even a small act of kindness, like giving water to a thirsty animal, can mean a lot to Allah. You lit the Kindness star!

dog/08-8b3439fc9e.mp3.text: Talk time. If you saw a thirsty bird or a hungry cat today, what is one kind thing you could do to help?

dog/09-22c7ae10b0.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Put out a bowl of water for the birds or a thirsty cat.

common/2c1109f804.mp3.text: Before you sleep, say: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya. In your name, O Allah, I die and I live. Good night.

ant/00-10159b70bc.mp3.text: Prophet Sulayman and the little ant. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

ant/01-4c56987ff8.mp3.text: Prophet Sulayman (Solomon), peace be upon him, was a very special prophet. Allah gave him a huge army of people, jinn, and birds, and He taught him to understand the speech of birds. He could even hear a tiny ant.

ant/02-05988534ee.mp3.text: One day Sulayman was marching with his whole army. They came to a valley full of ants.

ant/03-21a838c4dd.mp3.text: A little ant saw the big army coming and called out to the others: "O ants! Go into your homes, so that Sulayman and his soldiers don't crush you without realising it!"

ant/04-5984d17e3c.mp3.text: Sulayman heard the tiny ant, and he smiled. He wasn't angry. He was happy and thankful. He prayed: "My Lord, help me to be grateful for the blessings You gave me and my parents, and help me do good deeds that please You."

ant/05-80e6d13b26.mp3.text: We can imagine the great king making sure his army stepped carefully around the little ants. And the little ant looked after her friends too.

ant/06-97655ce04a.mp3.text: What we learned. Strong people are gentle with small creatures, and when Allah blesses us, we say thank you to Him. You lit the Gratitude star!

ant/07-88d285386a.mp3.text: Talk time. The ant warned her friends to keep them safe. How can you look out for your brothers, sisters, or friends?

ant/08-13fc45b271.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Notice three good things Allah gave you tomorrow, and say Alhamdulillah for each one.

gold/00-4a9b619929.mp3.text: The honest men and the jar of gold. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

gold/01-73540c43b6.mp3.text: Our Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him once told his companions a true story about two men who lived long, long ago, before his time.  One man owned a piece of land, and he sold it to another man.

gold/02-6a8ca0b644.mp3.text: The new owner was happy with his land, and he began to dig in it. Suddenly, his shovel hit something hard. He dug a little more and found a jar. He opened it, and it was full of shining gold!

gold/03-aacc61a64a.mp3.text: Now, he could have kept it all for himself. Nobody had seen him find it. But he knew Allah sees everything. So he picked up the jar and went straight to the man who sold him the land.

gold/04-2ab4d4066a.mp3.text: "Here, take your gold," he said. "I only bought the land from you. I didn't buy any gold."  But the other man shook his head. "No, no," he said. "I sold you the land and everything in it. The gold belongs to you."

gold/05-0d293f11c4.mp3.text: Each man wanted the other to have the gold! Neither of them wanted to take something that might not be his. So they went to a wise man and asked him to decide.  The wise man listened. Then he asked, "Do you have any children?"  The first man said, "I have a son."  The second man said, "I have a daughter."

gold/06-61063f3c53.mp3.text: The wise man smiled. "Then let your son and your daughter marry each other. Spend some of the gold on them, and give the rest in charity to help others."

gold/07-51dc2fdad1.mp3.text: And so the gold that both men were too honest to keep became a blessing for their children and for the poor.

gold/08-925e51f623.mp3.text: What we learned. Be honest even when nobody is watching, because Allah always sees us. When we don't take what isn't ours, Allah puts blessing (barakah) in what we have. You lit the Honesty star!

gold/09-cd0a399ee1.mp3.text: Talk time. If you found some money on the floor at school or in the park, and nobody saw you, what would you do? Why?

gold/10-e4638eecb2.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Tell the truth tomorrow, even about a small thing, just like the honest men.

uwais/00-b8b1439d66.mp3.text: Uwais and his mother. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

uwais/01-087bf7fdee.mp3.text: A long time ago, our Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him told his companion Umar about a man that Umar had never met. The man lived far away in Yemen, and his name was Uwais.

uwais/02-779d9d5008.mp3.text: The Prophet peace be upon him said: "One day, a man named Uwais will come to you with the travellers from Yemen. He once had a skin illness, and Allah healed him, except for one small spot the size of a coin. He has a mother, and he is very good to her. If he asks Allah for something, Allah answers him. So if you can, ask him to pray to Allah to forgive you."

uwais/03-53026e3b7f.mp3.text: Think about that! Uwais was not a king. He was not rich or famous. But Allah loved him so much, because of how kindly he treated his mother.

uwais/04-e105817f00.mp3.text: Many years later, Umar had become the leader of the Muslims. Every time a group of travellers came from Yemen, Umar would walk up to them and ask, "Is Uwais among you?" Again and again, the answer was no. But Umar never forgot, and he kept asking.

uwais/05-9cabc581f3.mp3.text: Then one day, a group arrived, and Umar asked again. And this time, there he was!

uwais/06-abf41d604d.mp3.text: "Are you Uwais?" asked Umar.  "Yes," said Uwais.  "Did you have a skin illness, and Allah healed it, except for a spot the size of a coin?"  "Yes."  "Do you have a mother?"  "Yes," said Uwais.

uwais/07-1e3509ba62.mp3.text: Then Umar told him what the Prophet peace be upon him had said about him, and asked, "Please, pray to Allah to forgive me." And Uwais made du'a for Umar.  Imagine that: Umar, the great leader of all the Muslims, asking a quiet, humble man to pray for him, all because that man took such good care of his mother.

uwais/08-ed91a4ce71.mp3.text: Umar then asked, "Where are you going?" Uwais said, "To Kufa." Umar offered to write a letter to the governor there so he would be looked after. But Uwais said, "I would rather stay among the ordinary, poor people." He didn't want to be treated as someone special.

uwais/09-a9757c408e.mp3.text: What we learned. Being kind and gentle to our parents is something Allah loves very much. You don't have to be famous or rich to be special to Allah: helping and obeying your mum and dad can make you beloved to Him. You lit the Care for parents star!

uwais/10-b0c883bbcf.mp3.text: Talk time. What is one kind thing you can do for Mama or Baba tomorrow, without them even asking?

uwais/11-b50541db10.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Help Mama or Baba with one job tomorrow, with a smile, before they ask you.

yunus/00-639317d50b.mp3.text: Prophet Yunus and the big fish. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

yunus/01-7fb8f00a96.mp3.text: A long time ago, Allah sent a prophet named Yunus to a town full of people. Yunus told them, "Worship only Allah, and be good." But the people would not listen. Day after day, they turned away.

yunus/02-4f1aea261f.mp3.text: Yunus became upset with them, and he left the town before Allah told him to go. He walked to the sea and got onto a ship that was very full and very heavy.

yunus/03-8f48c474d4.mp3.text: Out on the sea, the people on the ship decided to draw lots, a bit like picking a name out of a hat, to choose who had to leave the ship. And the name that came out was Yunus! So Yunus went into the water.

yunus/04-14d24eedd8.mp3.text: Then Allah sent a great big fish, and the fish swallowed Yunus whole!

yunus/05-5e2c755c01.mp3.text: Imagine how it felt inside. It was dark inside the fish. It was dark deep under the sea. And it was dark because it was night. Darkness, darkness, darkness. Yunus was all alone.

yunus/06-67af1d4c0c.mp3.text: But Yunus knew he was never really alone, because Allah is always with us and always hears us. So, right there in the dark, Yunus called out to Allah:  "La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin."  "There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have truly done wrong."  He was saying sorry to Allah, and remembering how great Allah is.

yunus/07-660276c3e0.mp3.text: And Allah heard him! Allah says in the Quran: "So We answered him and saved him from his sadness. And that is how We save the believers." Allah also tells us that if Yunus had not been someone who glorified Allah, he would have stayed inside that fish for a very, very long time.

yunus/08-7d38ef0de8.mp3.text: So the big fish threw Yunus out onto the beach. He was weak and tired. And Allah made a leafy plant grow over him, to give him shade and help him get strong again.

yunus/09-8c6150dd05.mp3.text: When Yunus was well, Allah sent him back to his people, more than a hundred thousand of them. And guess what? This time, they believed! They turned to Allah, and Allah let them enjoy their lives for a while.

yunus/10-a45d7b8540.mp3.text: Our Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him taught us that the du'a Yunus said inside the fish is very special: whenever a Muslim says it and asks Allah for something, Allah answers.

yunus/11-7cfcd8db1c.mp3.text: What we learned. Whenever we feel sad, scared, or know we did something wrong, we can always call out to Allah and say sorry. Allah hears us anywhere, even in the darkest place, and He loves to help those who turn to Him. You lit the Turning to Allah star!

yunus/12-79f718d530.mp3.text: Talk time. Where was Yunus when he made du'a, and can you learn his special du'a with me: "La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin"?

yunus/13-05dbe936b7.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. When something feels hard tomorrow, or you make a mistake, stop and say the du'a of Yunus, then ask Allah to help you.

three-men/00-5b6c4494aa.mp3.text: The three men and the angel. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

three-men/01-1669df60cd.mp3.text: Long ago, among the Children of Israel, there were three men. One had a sickness that made his skin sore and patchy. One had no hair at all, and people teased him. And one was blind and could not see anything.

three-men/02-703d35dc3c.mp3.text: Allah wanted to test them, so He sent an angel to each of them.

three-men/03-c8cf78d85f.mp3.text: The angel came to the first man and asked, "What would you love most?" He said, "Good skin and a healthy color, so people stop staying away from me." The angel wiped over him, and his skin became healthy and beautiful. Then the angel gave him a she-camel that was going to have a baby. "May Allah bless it for you," the angel said.

three-men/04-61cfd3f06b.mp3.text: The angel went to the second man and asked the same question. "Nice hair," he said, "so people stop making fun of me." The angel wiped over his head, and beautiful hair grew. The angel gave him a cow that was going to have a baby.

three-men/05-7bbaa33748.mp3.text: Then the angel went to the blind man. "What would you love most?" The man said softly, "That Allah gives me back my sight, so I can see people." The angel wiped over his eyes, and he could see! The angel gave him a sheep that was going to have a baby.

three-men/06-77396164b4.mp3.text: The years went by. The camel had babies, the cow had babies, the sheep had babies... until the first man had a whole valley full of camels, the second a valley full of cows, and the third a valley full of sheep. They were all rich now.

three-men/07-3f9985af93.mp3.text: Then the angel came back. But this time he looked like a poor, tired traveler, just like each man used to look.

three-men/08-a91690e60f.mp3.text: He went to the first man and said, "I am poor and far from home. I ask you, by the One who gave you good skin and all this wealth, please give me one camel to help me on my journey." But the man said, "I have too many things to pay for." The angel said, "Don't I know you? Weren't you the sick man people stayed away from, and then Allah gave you all this?" The man said, "No! I got all this from my family." The angel said, "If you are lying, may Allah make you as you were before."

three-men/09-7cef68ce2e.mp3.text: The angel asked the second man the same way, and he said the same thing, so the angel said the same words to him.

three-men/10-a2c2c29c7f.mp3.text: Then the angel went to the man who used to be blind. "I am a poor traveler," he said. "Please help me, by the One who gave you back your sight." The man said, "I was blind, and Allah gave me back my sight. I was poor, and Allah made me rich. Take whatever you want! By Allah, I won't stop you from taking anything for the sake of Allah."

three-men/11-d12717ffe8.mp3.text: The angel smiled and said, "Keep your wealth. You three were only being tested. Allah is pleased with you, and He is displeased with your two companions."

three-men/12-0c7a195740.mp3.text: What we learned. Everything good we have comes from Allah. We show we are thankful by remembering where it came from and by sharing it with others. You lit the Thankful giving star!

three-men/13-59378c0876.mp3.text: Talk time. What is one thing Allah has given you that you could share with someone else this week?

three-men/14-7fed38d3b6.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Share one of your things with someone tomorrow, like a snack or a toy, and say Alhamdulillah because Allah gave it to you.

guest/00-7abd952eeb.mp3.text: The guest and the dark lamp. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

guest/01-d7e51b194b.mp3.text: A long time ago in Madinah, a man came to the Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him. He was very, very hungry.

guest/02-5cd1a02c14.mp3.text: The Prophet peace be upon him sent a message to his own homes to ask for some food. But the answer came back: "We have nothing except water." The Prophet's own family had no food that day!

guest/03-4721db9f6b.mp3.text: So the Prophet peace be upon him turned to his companions and asked, "Who will take this guest home tonight and feed him?"

guest/04-c6c61512cb.mp3.text: A man from the Ansar, the helpers of Madinah, said, "I will, O Messenger of Allah!" And he took the hungry guest to his house.

guest/05-0ec24e86df.mp3.text: When he got home, he whispered to his wife, "We have a guest of the Prophet peace be upon him. Let's look after him well." But his wife whispered back, "We only have enough food for our children."

guest/06-0fdcebfe09.mp3.text: They thought for a moment. Then they made a plan. "Let's gently get the children to sleep," they said. "Then we'll give the food to our guest. And when he sits down to eat, we'll put out the lamp, so it's dark, and we'll pretend we are eating with him."

guest/07-c0e36a8c05.mp3.text: So that is what they did. The children were settled to sleep. The food was put in front of the guest. Then the wife got up as if to fix the lamp, and, oops, the lamp went out! In the dark, the husband and wife moved their hands and mouths as if they were eating too, so the guest would feel comfortable and eat as much as he wanted.

guest/08-a52be210b6.mp3.text: The guest ate until he was full. And the kind husband and wife went to bed hungry that night, with happy hearts.

guest/09-e28fa19ba3.mp3.text: The next morning, the man went to the Prophet peace be upon him. The Prophet peace be upon him told him that Allah was pleased with what he and his wife had done for their guest last night. Nobody had told the Prophet about it! Allah Himself sent down a verse in the Quran about people like them:  "...and they give others preference over themselves, even if they are in need." (Quran 59:9)

guest/10-95f0faee6d.mp3.text: Imagine that: a small dinner in a dark room, and Allah sent down a verse about it in the Quran that we still read today!

guest/11-77b902e628.mp3.text: What we learned. When we share what we have, even when it's not much, Allah sees it and loves it, even if no one else knows. You lit the Putting others first star!

guest/12-3264e888ca.mp3.text: Talk time. If you had only one cookie left and your friend was hungry, what would you do? Why?

guest/13-42f7b1eba3.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Tomorrow, let someone else go first or share part of something you like, and keep it a quiet secret between you and Allah.

ayyub/00-146d8c3edf.mp3.text: Prophet Ayyub the patient. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

ayyub/01-8d9e26022d.mp3.text: A long time ago, there lived a prophet named Ayyub, peace be upon him. Allah had given him many blessings. He had a family he loved, good health, and plenty of everything he needed. And Ayyub always said thank you to Allah.

ayyub/02-c110934654.mp3.text: Then one day, things changed. Ayyub became very, very sick. It was not a sickness that went away in a day or a week. It stayed for a long, long time. His body hurt, he grew tired and weak, and he lost many of the good things he once had.

ayyub/03-af081ff57e.mp3.text: Some people might get angry or give up when something like that happens. But not Ayyub. He did not complain about Allah. He kept remembering Allah, he kept praying, and he waited patiently.

ayyub/04-358467f64c.mp3.text: And when he called out to Allah, he did it in the most beautiful and polite way. The Quran tells us his words. He said:  "Indeed, harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

ayyub/05-b234bac171.mp3.text: Can you hear how gentle that is? He did not shout, "Why me?" He simply told Allah how he felt, and he reminded himself that Allah is the Most Merciful of all.

ayyub/06-c4f2d36063.mp3.text: Allah heard Ayyub's prayer. And Allah told him: "Strike the ground with your foot!"

ayyub/07-5df97725d5.mp3.text: Ayyub tapped the ground with his foot, and, subhanAllah, cool, fresh water came flowing out. Allah told him this water was for washing and for drinking. Ayyub washed with it and drank from it, and Allah took away his sickness.

ayyub/08-d1071d94bb.mp3.text: But Allah gave him even more than that. Allah gave him back his family, and as many more again along with them, as a mercy from Allah and a reminder for everyone who thinks and understands.

ayyub/09-9fce7ee927.mp3.text: And then Allah said something very special about Ayyub in the Quran:  "Indeed, We found him patient. What an excellent servant! Indeed, he constantly turned back to Allah."

ayyub/10-4fa9fdf9a4.mp3.text: Imagine Allah Himself calling you "an excellent servant"! Ayyub earned that by being patient and always turning to Allah, even when things were hard.

ayyub/11-49a5139db0.mp3.text: What we learned. When something hard happens, like being sick, feeling sad, or losing something we love, we stay patient, we keep praying, and we tell Allah how we feel politely, because Allah is the Most Merciful and He hears us. You lit the Patience star!

ayyub/12-19d589d9e1.mp3.text: Talk time. What is something hard that happened to you, and what could you say to Allah, like Prophet Ayyub did, the next time you feel that way?

ayyub/13-1fa8651cce.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. When something feels hard tomorrow, like a sore tummy, a lost toy or a long wait, try not to complain. Tell Allah gently how you feel, just like Prophet Ayyub did.

yusuf/00-967ea79b1e.mp3.text: Prophet Yusuf forgives his brothers. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

yusuf/01-0984618189.mp3.text: A long time ago there was a boy named Yusuf. His father was Prophet Yaqub, and he loved Yusuf very much. One night Yusuf had a special dream: he saw eleven stars, the sun, and the moon bowing down to him. His father said, "Keep this dream to yourself, my son. Allah has chosen you for something good."

yusuf/02-312d51650b.mp3.text: But Yusuf's older brothers were jealous. "Our father loves Yusuf more than us," they grumbled. So they made a bad plan. They took Yusuf out to play, and then they threw him into a deep, dark well!

yusuf/03-b7b67c9560.mp3.text: They went home in the evening, crying fake tears, and told their father, "A wolf ate Yusuf." Their father was very sad, but he said, "Beautiful patience. Allah is the One whose help I seek."

yusuf/04-d4d82b2bf1.mp3.text: Yusuf was all alone at the bottom of the well. But he was not really alone, because Allah was with him.

yusuf/05-b22fd26b93.mp3.text: Some travelers came by, lowered a bucket for water, and found a boy inside! They took Yusuf to the land of Egypt.

yusuf/06-2f8b9fe5d6.mp3.text: Many years passed. Yusuf grew up to be honest, wise, and kind. He went through many hard times, but he always remembered Allah. In the end, the king of Egypt put Yusuf in charge of all the food in the land.

yusuf/07-a13b7ccc46.mp3.text: Then a terrible hunger came, and people traveled from far away to get food. Guess who came? Yusuf's brothers! They stood in front of him, but they did not know who he was. Yusuf knew them right away.

yusuf/08-802c9b46cb.mp3.text: Now Yusuf was strong and powerful. He could have punished them for what they did. But what did he do? He said to them, "Do you remember what you did to Yusuf?" They looked closely and gasped, "Are you... Yusuf?" He said, "I am Yusuf. Allah has been kind to us."

yusuf/09-d8b01bcef6.mp3.text: The brothers were ashamed. "We were wrong," they said. And Yusuf said the most beautiful words: "No blame upon you today. May Allah forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful."

yusuf/10-d1592435c4.mp3.text: Then Yusuf brought his whole family to Egypt, and his father Yaqub hugged him again after all those years. Allah made the dream come true, and the family was together again, because Yusuf chose to forgive.

yusuf/11-f4f15540f7.mp3.text: What we learned. When someone hurts us and later says sorry, we can be like Prophet Yusuf: forgive them with a big heart, just as we hope Allah forgives us. You lit the Forgiveness star!

yusuf/12-0a8503750a.mp3.text: Talk time. Has anyone ever done something that made you sad? What could you say to them to forgive them, like Yusuf did?

yusuf/13-e6efc8cc88.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Tomorrow, if someone upsets you and then says sorry, forgive them with a big heart and say, "It's okay, I forgive you." Then make du'a that Allah forgives you both.

ibrahim/00-5502112af6.mp3.text: Prophet Ibrahim and the fire. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

ibrahim/01-fb31f56878.mp3.text: A long, long time ago, there lived a young man named Ibrahim. Allah had given him wisdom, even when he was young.

ibrahim/02-84d9da43d5.mp3.text: In Ibrahim's town, the people did something very strange. They carved statues out of stone and wood, and they bowed down to them. They called them their gods.

ibrahim/03-62605ea126.mp3.text: Ibrahim asked his father and his people, "What are these statues that you sit and worship all day?"  They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them, so we do the same."

ibrahim/04-47cbf16c08.mp3.text: Ibrahim said, "Then you and your fathers have been making a clear mistake! Your real Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. He is the One who made them."

ibrahim/05-1f81ca5872.mp3.text: One day, the people went out of town. Ibrahim went into the place where the statues stood. He broke them all into pieces, all except the biggest one. He left that one standing.

ibrahim/06-cfe37a3d93.mp3.text: When the people came back, they gasped. "Who did this to our gods?"  Someone said, "We heard a young man talking about them. His name is Ibrahim."

ibrahim/07-0c64c2a1b2.mp3.text: So they brought Ibrahim in front of everyone. "Did you do this to our gods, O Ibrahim?"  Ibrahim gave a clever answer. "Why not ask the big one? Ask them, if they can speak!"

ibrahim/08-76246bbc7f.mp3.text: The people went quiet. They looked down. They knew statues cannot speak. They cannot help anyone, and they cannot hurt anyone.  Ibrahim said, "Then why do you worship things instead of Allah that cannot help you or harm you at all?"

ibrahim/09-150172eb8e.mp3.text: But instead of listening, the people became angry. They said, "Burn him! Protect your gods!"

ibrahim/10-e2c1f82005.mp3.text: They built a huge fire and threw Ibrahim into it. But Ibrahim was not alone. Allah was with him.

ibrahim/11-695b5e3e89.mp3.text: Allah said: "O fire, be cool and safe for Ibrahim."

ibrahim/12-588f95c722.mp3.text: And the fire obeyed! It did not burn Ibrahim. He was safe. The people tried to harm him, but Allah made them the losers, and He saved Ibrahim.

ibrahim/13-66f1523200.mp3.text: What we learned. Ibrahim was brave because he trusted Allah. When we stand up for what is right, even when others don't, Allah is with us. You lit the Courage and trust star!

ibrahim/14-0e11adeead.mp3.text: Talk time. If all your friends were doing something wrong, what could you do to be brave like Ibrahim?

ibrahim/15-3bbe2223eb.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Tomorrow, if you see someone doing something wrong, be brave and gentle. Say, "Let's not do that," or tell a grown-up you trust. Then ask Allah to make your heart strong.

rain/00-03f9de6c3f.mp3.text: The rain that woke the earth. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

rain/01-2bfe198ddb.mp3.text: Once upon a time, there was a field that was very, very thirsty.  It hadn't rained for a long time. The ground was hard and cracked, like a dry cookie. The grass had turned brown and crunchy.

rain/02-4eeed284ce.mp3.text: The little flowers had closed their petals and gone to sleep. Even the worms had wriggled deep down, looking for a cool, wet place to hide.

rain/03-9920e4b3fe.mp3.text: The birds flew over the field and said, "Tweet, tweet, no water here." The bunny hopped by and sniffed. "No fresh green leaves today," she sighed.

rain/04-04c1ae49af.mp3.text: Then one afternoon, something changed. The wind began to blow, whoooosh. Far away, big grey clouds started to gather, puffy and heavy, like giant sponges full of water.

rain/05-5b67b6fd5f.mp3.text: Who was sending them? Allah was. He tells the winds where to go, and He drives the clouds across the sky.

rain/06-449f763b0f.mp3.text: Drip. One drop fell on a dry leaf. Drip, drip. Two more landed on a rock.

rain/07-c95fde956a.mp3.text: And then, pitter-patter, pitter-patter, the rain came down, soft and steady, all night long.

rain/08-cbbb82e66a.mp3.text: The thirsty ground drank and drank. Gulp, gulp! The cracks filled up. The worms came wiggling back up, happy.

rain/09-4378cb4476.mp3.text: The sleepy seeds hidden in the soil felt the cool water and whispered, "Is it time? Is it time to wake up?"

rain/10-2bcd017c6a.mp3.text: And when the sun came out in the morning, guess what? Tiny green shoots were poking out of the ground! Little by little, day by day, the brown field turned green again.

rain/11-1f228d615f.mp3.text: The flowers opened up: yellow, pink, and purple. The bees came buzzing. The birds splashed in puddles. The bunny found lots of yummy leaves to munch.  The field that looked so tired and empty was full of life again.

rain/12-e656d3c043.mp3.text: Allah tells us about this in the Quran:  "So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah — how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness." (Surah Ar-Rum, 30:50)

rain/13-39fafe61dc.mp3.text: The rain is a gift of Allah's mercy. It reminds us of one of His beautiful names: Ar-Rahman, the Most Merciful. He takes care of the dry ground, the little seeds, the birds, the bunnies, and the bees. And He takes care of us too: the water we drink, the food we eat, and the hugs we share.

rain/14-f940d0b31b.mp3.text: When the Prophet peace be upon him saw rain, he would make a little du'a:  "Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a." "O Allah, make it a beneficial rain." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1032)

rain/15-15fdd4534e.mp3.text: So next time you hear pitter-patter on the window, you can say it too, and smile, because Allah's mercy is falling all around you.

rain/16-fe357f8222.mp3.text: What we learned. Every drop of rain is a gift from Allah, Ar-Rahman, the Most Merciful, who takes care of everything He made, so we thank Him for His mercy. You lit the Thankful for mercy star!

rain/17-74eb4be6b8.mp3.text: Talk time. What is one thing Allah's mercy gave you today, like rain, food, or your family, that you want to say "Alhamdulillah" for?

rain/18-aa1a33e227.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Tomorrow, give a thirsty plant or a little bird some water, and say "Alhamdulillah" for one gift of Allah's mercy that you can see.

camel/00-039297601d.mp3.text: The camel who cried. Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

camel/01-35384f4c90.mp3.text: A long time ago, in the city of Madinah, there were gardens full of tall palm trees. One day, the Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him walked into one of these gardens. It belonged to a man from the Ansar, the helpers of Madinah.

camel/02-bfc85ce1bb.mp3.text: In the garden there was a camel. A big camel, with long legs and a tall hump.  But this camel was not happy.

camel/03-3e6e6b12b0.mp3.text: When the camel saw the Prophet peace be upon him, it made a sad, sad sound, a long groan, like someone who has been waiting a long time to tell their troubles. And then something amazing happened. Tears began to roll from the camel's big eyes. Drip... drip... The camel was crying.

camel/04-24b7b58ee0.mp3.text: Have you ever seen an animal cry? The camel was trying to say something, and the Prophet peace be upon him understood.

camel/05-443ff43cb6.mp3.text: The Prophet peace be upon him did not walk away. He did not say, "It's just a camel." He went right up to it, gently, and he stroked the camel softly behind its head and ears, the way you might comfort a friend who is upset.

camel/06-f829e15dd0.mp3.text: And slowly, slowly, the camel became calm. Its crying stopped. It felt safe.

camel/07-a1850a059c.mp3.text: Then the Prophet peace be upon him asked, "Who owns this camel?"  A young man from the Ansar came running. "It is mine, O Messenger of Allah!"

camel/08-c3f7399ce8.mp3.text: The Prophet peace be upon him said to him:  "Do you not fear Allah regarding this animal that Allah has given you? It has complained to me that you keep it hungry and make it work too hard." (Sunan Abi Dawud 2549)

camel/09-87236c8572.mp3.text: Imagine that! The camel could not talk in words, but it told the Prophet peace be upon him what was wrong. It was hungry. It was tired. It needed someone to take care of it properly.

camel/10-c35a76aab6.mp3.text: The Prophet peace be upon him was teaching the young man, and all of us, something very important: animals are not toys or machines. Allah made them, Allah gave them to us, and Allah sees how we treat them. They feel hunger. They feel tired. They feel sad. And they feel happy when someone is kind to them.

camel/11-1271e64812.mp3.text: So when we give our cat some water, when we feed the birds a few crumbs, when we are gentle with a little puppy and don't pull its tail, we are following the Prophet peace be upon him, who was kind even to a crying camel.

camel/12-b09e36d065.mp3.text: What we learned. Allah sees how we treat animals, so like the Prophet peace be upon him, we should be gentle with them, feed them, and never make them suffer. You lit the Caring for animals star!

camel/13-f52a2dd8a6.mp3.text: Talk time. If you had a pet camel (or a cat, or a bird), what are three things you would do every day to make sure it is happy and cared for?

camel/14-81b3dd51a0.mp3.text: Tomorrow's kindness mission. Tomorrow, give an animal some fresh water or a little food, gently, like a pet, a bird or a cat outside, and say "Bismillah" as you do it.
